meta: Practice job interviews in English with AI: fluent in Vietnamese but tongue-tied in English? Let AI play the recruiter.

muc.title: Tongue-tied in interviews
muc.text: Fluent in Vietnamese, tongue-tied in English. Let AI play the recruiter.

muc.title: Paste the job description
muc.text: Paste the job description and ask AI to ask one question at a time like a real interview, waiting for your answer before the next.

muc.title: Answer out loud
muc.text: Turn on voice mode and answer out loud, because a real interview doesn't let you sit and type.

muc.title: Ask for specific feedback
muc.text: At the end, ask AI to grade each answer, point out grammar mistakes and give a tighter sample answer.

muc.title: Introducing yourself
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to ask you to introduce yourself in English, answer, then ask for three pieces of feedback.

thu: Ask a chatbot to ask you "Tell me about yourself", answer in English, then ask for three pieces of feedback.
